name: Fire Bolt, Greater
body:
School evocation [fire]; Level magus 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

This spell functions like fire bolt except the bolt deals 1d6 damage plus 1d6 per 2 levels (max 5d6). The bolt will ignite flammable substances it hits.
